text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Maryam Abacha on Monday became the first ever Nigerian first lady to address the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) assembly of heads of state and government in its 34-year history.

- The OAU's 33rd assembly opened in Harare on Monday amid pomp and splendour as African leaders and representatives gathered to map out strategies to help transform the continent to prosperity in the next 12 months.
- Salim Ahmed Salim will continue as OAU Secretary-General after he was overwhelmingly elected on Monday to head the organisation's secretariat for another four years.
- Salim Ahmed Salim on Monday said the OAU's success in facing its new challenge of forging an economic co-operation community would greatly depend on the economic successes of individual countries.
